purpose: An HTTPS response advertises h2c, the cleartext variant of HTTP/2, as an alternative service.

groundTruth.rationale: The alternative-service advertisement names a protocol that runs without TLS, so a client following it sends later requests to the same origin in cleartext.

limitations: Observation mode: a synthetic response object, not a live target.
